faq.a1: A sticker, table stand, sign, card or poster with your QR code.
faq.q2: When will I see the price?
faq.a2: This demo uses an illustrative price. In the finished service, the full price will be calculated automatically after you choose a format, size and quantity — before payment.
faq.a3: In the finished service, you’ll pay online after reviewing your choices and the total. Online payment isn’t available in this demo.
faq.q4: How will my order be delivered?
faq.a4: In the finished service, you’ll be able to choose delivery to a branch or parcel locker. Delivery isn’t connected in this demo.
faq.q5: Do I need an app to scan a QR code?
faq.a5: Most modern phones can open QR codes with their camera. What happens next depends on the phone and its settings.
faq.q6: What do I need for a menu, document or booking?
faq.a6: A published link to your menu, document or booking page. Those files and bookings stay with the service you already use.
faq.q7: Can I change the details after printing?
faq.a7: The QR code stores your details when it’s made. If they change after printing, you’ll need a new print.
